settings.heading: Questions before your next project
settings.text: Find practical information about artwork, personalization, ordering and project planning. For a product-specific answer, send us your project details.

settings.heading: What else would you like to know?

settings.question: Where is Elma Vada based?
settings.answer: Our studio is based in Plano, Texas, in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Contact us to discuss your project and any visit or collection arrangements.

settings.question: What information should I send for a quote?
settings.answer: Share the occasion, estimated quantity, target date, delivery location and any artwork you already have. A budget range helps narrow the options.

settings.question: Can every gift have a different name?
settings.answer: Include personalization requirements in your request. We will confirm the suitable product, method and recipient-list format for the project.

settings.question: Can I review a mockup or sample first?
settings.answer: Ask about digital mockup and physical sample options. Availability, cost and timing are confirmed for your project before you commit.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Timing depends on product availability, quantity, artwork approval and fulfillment. Your quote will set out the proposed schedule; please share any fixed event date.

settings.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
settings.answer: Minimums depend on the product, material and production method. Send your estimated quantity so we can confirm suitability and pricing.

settings.question: Can you work with my existing artwork?
settings.answer: Share your logo or design and any brand guidelines. Vector files are helpful; we will review the file and confirm any preparation needed.

settings.question: Can you engrave items I already own?
settings.answer: Send the exact product, material, dimensions and quantity before bringing or shipping items. Suitability and any risks need to be reviewed first.

settings.question: Can I request gift packaging?
settings.answer: Yes, include presentation and packing requirements in your inquiry so available options can be discussed and included in the quote.

settings.question: Can gifts be sent to different recipients?
settings.answer: Tell us how many destinations are involved and the required dates. Availability, address handling and fulfillment charges must be confirmed for the project.

settings.question: Do you handle repeat orders?
settings.answer: Tell us which project or design you want to repeat. We will review current product availability, quantities and any changes before quoting.

settings.question: Can you meet a fixed event date?
settings.answer: Share the date at the start. We will review material availability and production requirements before confirming a schedule; do not assume a rush order is available.

settings.heading: What do you have in mind?
settings.text: Tell us who the gift is for, your estimated quantity and your target date. We will help you define the next step.
